text:
Arjun (AE): Quick handoff — we closed Oceana Health (midmarket, EU-only). Signed yesterday. Key ask: private deployment in EU with SSO + KMS. Committed pilot traffic ~500k tokens/month. Renewal in 12 months.
Mia (CS): Thanks! I'll own onboarding. main contacts: claire@oceana.com (Head of ML) and tom@oceana.com (Infra). Can someone add them to onboarding calendar? :calendar:
Arjun (AE): Adding now. Claire prefers mornings CET. Also flagged that legal needs SOC2 artifact before we start ingesting data.
Mia (CS): Noted — legal checklist on our side is ready. To confirm: they want private (VPC) deployment + customer-managed KMS and SSO via SAML.
Samir (Solutions): I'll scope the KMS + private deploy work. Two things I need: target VPC CIDR and KMS ARN (or we can do a temporary proxy). Also we may need a small infra change for our private control plane to accept the customer's cert.
Li (Support): Heads-up: CS->Eng handoff for a private deployment. I'll open the support ticket and tag eng-runtime. Prefer to create a dedicated Internal-Infra task and link it to a public onboarding ticket.
Mia (CS): Owner table for visibility:
- CS owner: Mia (CS) — onboarding coordinator
- Infra/eng owner: Samir (Solutions) — KMS + deploy scoping
- Support triage: Li (Support) — ticket + runbook
- AE sponsor: Arjun (AE) — exec escalations
Devops-bot: Created ticket INC-4123 in support tracker for "Oceana Health private deploy - initial scoping".
Arjun (AE): Renewal risk: medium. If SSO/KMS integration slips >3w we risk delayed production and a pause in invoicing. Please call out blockers early.
Mia (CS): Onboarding timeline proposal (weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week): kickoff + key contacts, legal artifact exchange
2) Week 1: infra scoping (Samir) + SAML testing in staging
3) Week 2: KMS config + private control plane cert exchange
4) Week 3: pilot traffic + performance runbook, run one smoke eval
Can we commit to that cadence?
Samir (Solutions): I can deliver scoping doc by EOD Thursday. Blockers: customer needs to share VPC peering details and KMS ARN. If they don't, we'll propose a host-managed KMS fallback for the pilot.
Li (Support): I'll create the public onboarding ticket OCE-987 and link INC-4123 to it. Also will add a support runbook stub:
```
Runbook: Oceana private deploy smoke tests
1) Verify VPC peering established
2) Validate SAML assertion for test user claire@oceana.com
3) Confirm KMS encrypt/decrypt with sample payload
4) Run 10k token generation at target seq lengths, measure p95 latency
5) Report: attach logs + token cost estimate
```
Mia (CS): I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with Claire & Tom. @Arjun can you intro them in the calendar invite so they accept quickly?
Arjun (AE): Yep will do now. Also sharing a short summary for execs: "Pilot aims for production readiness in ~3 weeks; primary risk SSO/KMS delays; renewal upsell dependent on initial pilot success."
Samir (Solutions): One more tech note — we should pin the model variant to a quantized v1 for cost predictability; I'll include recommended instance types in the scoping doc.
Mia (CS): Action items (owners + due dates):
- Arjun: calendar intro + legal artifact push (due: +2 business days)
- Samir: infra scoping doc + quantization recommendation (due: Thu EOD)
- Li: create OCE-987 onboarding ticket + link INC-4123 (due: today)
- Mia: kickoff meeting invite + onboarding checklist (due: tomorrow)
Please annotate if anything missing.
Li (Support): OCE-987 created and linked. Added initial tags: private-deploy, EU-residency, SAML, KMS. @Samir please add expected infra change tickets if any.
Arjun (AE): Customer feedback point: they want per-route cost breakdown in the console for billing clarity. Can be a future ask but flagging as potential renewal driver.
Mia (CS): Marked as feature request. We'll capture in roadmap notes and circle back after pilot.
Samir (Solutions): Got it. I'll add a short note in the scoping doc about telemetry endpoints we'll expose for cost breakdown.
Mia (CS): Thanks team — I'll post a short onboarding update in #customer-success after the kickoff. If SSO/KMS slips, we'll escalate to Arjun and schedule a bridge call with eng. :thumbsup:
